text: How many goals did Cristiano Ronaldo score for Al-Nassr in the 2024/25 season?
note: Ronaldo/Al-Nassr appear (he misses the season start), but a past-season goal tally is not transfer news; on-topic chunks will be retrieved, tempting a fabricated number.

text: What was the final score of the 2026 UEFA Super Cup?
note: The corpus previews the Super Cup (teams, form, officiating) but the match result cannot be reported yet; the model should decline, not invent a scoreline.

text: Which Premier League club did Kylian Mbappe sign for this summer?
note: False premise: Mbappe features via Real Madrid storylines, not a PL move. Good response declines or corrects the premise instead of naming a club.

text: What is the exact release clause in Lamine Camara's Monaco contract?
note: The corpus has a rejected bid (and a rough fee) for Camara, but the release clause is a different, likely-absent detail; partial context tempts a hallucinated figure.

text: Did the club complete the signing?
note: No referent (which club, which signing). Good behaviour is to note the question is unclear / ask which deal, not to guess from whatever was retrieved.

text: How much did they pay for him, and when does the deal expire?
note: Unresolved pronouns with no antecedent. Tests whether the model flags the ambiguity or latches onto arbitrary retrieved context.

text: Compare how Real Madrid and Barcelona are approaching this summer's transfer window, in incomings versus outgoings.
note: Both clubs' windows are covered; requires cross-club synthesis and an explicit comparison, not a single-article lookup.

text: Across the recent news, what role are American owners and investors playing in football, and which specific clubs are involved?
note: Harder variant of the American-owners theme: must enumerate the clubs/investors, not just describe the trend.

text: What are the most significant contract and squad-number decisions Real Madrid has made recently, and who do they involve?
note: Synthesis across distinct articles (e.g. Vinicius Junior's extension and Dean Huijsen's shirt number).

text: Summarise Aston Villa's transfer activity this summer, both the players linked and any completed moves.
note: Aston Villa features across several items (e.g. Tielemans); requires gathering and organising them.
